title: Fiscal Policy Tools for Social Progress

highwire_tags.citation_title: Fiscal Policy Tools for Social Progress
highwire_tags.citation_journal_title: Global Research Journal of Economics and Social Development
highwire_tags.citation_abstract:
Research Objective: This study examined fiscal policy tools for social progress.

Methodology: A qualitative case study was used.

Findings: Targeted transfers enlarge opportunity.

Conclusion: Coordinated fiscal action is decisive.
